breaking_changes.BC_description: Node.js support has been dropped for versions earlier than 18.19.0 and versions between 20.0.0 and 20.4.0.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Upgrade Node.js to version 18.19.0 or higher, or if using version 20, upgrade to at least version 20.5.0.

breaking_changes.BC_description: When the encoding option is set to 'buffer', the output (result.stdout, result.stderr, result.all) now returns an Uint8Array instead of a Buffer.

Several encoding option values have been renamed, including: null to 'buffer', 'utf-8' to 'utf8', 'UTF8' to 'utf8', 'utf-16le' to 'utf16le', 'ucs2' to 'utf16le', 'ucs-2' to 'utf16le', and 'binary' to 'latin1'.

The methods for piping output to files (subprocess.pipeStdout(), subprocess.pipeStderr(), and subprocess.pipeAll()) have been removed. Instead, the file path should be provided as an object with a 'file' property to the stdout or stderr option.

The methods for piping output to writable streams (subprocess.pipeStdout(), subprocess.pipeStderr(), and subprocess.pipeAll()) have been removed. Instead, the stream should be passed directly to the stdout or stderr option, or as ['pipe', stream] if the stream does not have a file descriptor.

The subprocess.pipeStdout(), subprocess.pipeStderr(), and subprocess.pipeAll() methods have been renamed to subprocess.pipe(). The command and arguments can now be passed directly to subprocess.pipe() without calling execa() again. The 'from' option can specify the source stream ('stdout', 'stderr', or 'all').
The 'signal' option has been renamed to 'cancelSignal'.
The error.killed property has been renamed to error.isTerminated.
The subprocess.cancel() method has been removed. Use subprocess.kill() or the cancelSignal option instead.
The forceKillAfterTimeout option has been renamed to forceKillAfterDelay, and is now passed to execa() instead of to subprocess.kill().
The verbose option is now a string enum instead of a boolean. The value false has been renamed to 'none' and true has been renamed to 'short'.
The execPath option has been renamed to nodePath. It is now a noop unless the node option is true. It now works even if the preferLocal option is false.

The default serialization option is now 'advanced' instead of 'json'. When calling subprocess.send(object) with an object that contains functions or symbols, those were previously silently removed. Now this will throw an exception.

If subprocess.stdout, subprocess.stderr or subprocess.all is manually piped, the .pipe() call must now happen as soon as subprocess is created. Otherwise, the output at the beginning of the subprocess might be missing.
Signals passed to subprocess.kill() and to the killSignal option cannot be lowercase anymore, they must be uppercase.
